component_encoding.client_id: lowercase SHA-256 hex of the stable opaque client identity
component_encoding.key: lowercase SHA-256 hex of the raw idempotency key

retention.live_pubsub: non-persistent channel; consumers recover from the stream or SQLite

rules: Every key and channel is scoped under mpvweb:v1; never issue unprefixed application keys.
Redis never contains the only durable copy of queue, resume, history, profile, auth, or media facts.
All ephemeral state keys have a documented TTL or bounded stream policy.
Player leases use unique holder tokens and token-checked renewal/release.
Pub/Sub is low-latency fanout only; recovery must not depend on it.
